meta.note: Brand colours and logo come from the repo. Everything else was designed new for the rebuild: dark-first infrastructure direction requested by the owner, with a reference screenshot as the aesthetic guide.

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Palette step. Lightest brand wash; base of primary-soft in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Palette step. Hover wash on brand-50 surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-200
tokens.usage: Palette step. primary-soft-text in dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-300
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark-theme primary-hover and focus ring; glow highlights.

tokens.name: brand-400
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark-theme primary: the luminous Disol blue on near-black (7.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: THE Disol blue: the logo tile and repo's blue_v. Use for the logo, large brand fills, illustrations and charts. White text on it is 3.5:1, so only at 24px+ or 19px bold; actions use primary instead.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Palette step, from the repo's hover state. Light-theme primary: white text 4.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Palette step, from the repo's hover state. Light-theme primary-hover and primary-soft-text (6.25:1 with white).

tokens.name: brand-800
tokens.usage: Palette step. Pressed state, deep brand bands.

tokens.name: brand-900
tokens.usage: Palette step. Deepest brand tone for marketing hero bands with white text.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the default for the client platform and marketing; light for long-form docs and the ERP when chosen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, sidebars: the default container.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, disabled inputs, code blocks, wells inside a surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, modals, toasts: anything floating above a surface. Pair with shadow-lg.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, list items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, not enough contrast to be the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised and surface-hover (14:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, placeholders, mono meta on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised, surface-hover (5.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse fills (tooltips, the dark sidebar variant).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip and snackbar fill, with text-inverse on it.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill, links, active nav, checked controls, live connectors. As text it reads on bg and surface in both themes (4.6:1 or more); in light not on surface-sunken (4.3:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover (4.9:1 or more). Dark text in the dark theme, never white.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav background, brand badge and info alert fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft (10.8:1 dark, 5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, 2px offset. 3.5:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Light bloom behind primary CTAs, live connectors, featured cards and hero visuals. Never behind body text.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid background pattern (ds-grid-bg) on hero and canvas areas.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent panels over glow/hero art (navbar on scroll, floating canvases), with backdrop blur.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and fills. Darkened from the repo's green_v #469f78, which fails as text (3.2:1). Text on a success fill is on-success.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill (5.3:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and alert fill, with success text on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. The dark value is the repo's yallow_v.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: The repo's yallow_v as a solid fill (banner, chart bar, highlight). Text on it is on-warning, never white.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning-fill in both themes (10.2:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and alert fill, with warning text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, invalid borders. Darkened from the repo's red_error #f84141 (3.4:1 on white, fails as text).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on danger buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (5.5:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and badge fill, with danger text on it.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series. Always the Disol blue.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series. From the repo's Rose_b_v, darkened in light theme to keep 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series. From yallow_v, darkened in light theme.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. From green_v.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series and 'other' bucket.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer backdrop.

families.sans: Geist, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", Geist, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero headline, one per page. Pair the last word or phrase with display-accent.

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: The italic serif accent inside a display headline: one phrase, never a whole sentence, never in product UI.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in the client platform and ERP.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Disol builds, hosts and runs the software your business depends on.
styles.usage: Marketing lead paragraphs. text-muted on dark.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your request was received. A Disol engineer replies within one business day.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis, button labels, table row titles.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text and captions, in text-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, axis labels. Smallest size for content.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Technical labels: Tags, status pills, node meta, fine print under CTAs, nav status. Lowercase. This is the voice that signals 'we run infrastructure'.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, invoice numbers, log lines, API keys, CLI snippets, durations (134 ms).

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic hero headline. No serif accent; emphasise with primary colour instead.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: مناقشة فكرة الموقع وأهدافه والمتطلبات اللازمة.
styles.usage: Arabic UI and body text, one step larger than body.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Use only these steps for padding, gaps and margins.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Optical nudges: badge vertical padding, icon offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, compact cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, table cell padding, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, default stack gap, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in dense ERP screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section spacing in apps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, marketing block spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding (desktop).

radius.note: Rounded but not soft: the logo is built from quarter-circles, so corners are visible on every control.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, small badges, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs in dense tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, marketing panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Marketing CTAs, status pills, tags, avatars, switches.

shadow.note: Borders first. Shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards. In dark a 1px top highlight gives the panel edge.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, flow nodes.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, toasts, floating hero canvases.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary CTA hover, featured ServiceCard and PricingCard, the live FlowNode. At most two glowing things per screen.

size.note: Control heights. Every input, select and button in a row shares one.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense tables, toolbars, filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing CTAs, mobile primary actions, auth forms.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded app sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: App top bar and marketing navbar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of marketing content and the client platform.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and top bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal, drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above modals.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones. Forms go two-column above it.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets. Sidebar collapses to a drawer below it.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops. Sidebar is always shown above it.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop. Max content width for dashboards.
